🚀 Join a strategic modernization programme focused on transforming a mission-critical Portfolio Management System used by investment professionals.

Modernize and enhance existing .NET and WPF applications
Design and develop REST APIs and integrations
Improve application performance, scalability and reliability
Reduce technical debt and contribute to architecture improvements
Build solutions across desktop, web and service layers
Contribute to AI-powered user experiences and workflow automation
 What we're looking for: 
 ✔ Strong experience with C#, .NET, WPF, XAML and MVVM
 ✔ Experience with Portfolio Management, Trading, OMS or EMS platforms
 ✔ Hands-on experience with REST APIs and ASP.NET Core
 ✔ Python and SQL Server knowledge
 ✔ Strong troubleshooting, performance tuning and debugging skills
 ✔ Experience with Git, CI/CD and Azure DevOps
 ➕ Experience with React, Angular, Azure, Kubernetes, MongoDB or AI/LLM technologies is a plus.
 🌍 International financial services project
 📈 Opportunity to modernize a large-scale investment platform and shape its future architecture
